subject: Temporary invoice-only pathway for pilot vendors — threshold & controls
messages:
From: Olivia Park <procurement@orbitlabs.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Jordan,

We're kicking off a 60-day pilot with Redwood for a small set of inference workloads. Our procurement team is slow to stand up new PO processes for pilots, and our internal policy would block a PO before the pilot starts. Can Orbit Labs be onboarded under an invoice-only (no PO) arrangement for the first 90 days while we finalize our internal PO workflow? Expected spend is ~$3k–6k total over the pilot.

Happy to share a completed vendor intake form and a W-9. Attached is our procurement contact info.

Thanks —
Olivia Park
Procurement Lead, Orbit Labs
procurement@orbitlabs.com

Attachments: orbit_w9.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <procurement@orbitlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the note and context — appreciate the heads-up. We can consider a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, subject to a short set of controls so we can track risk and reconcile billing. High-level we typically require:
- Completed vendor intake form (I attached our standard PDF)
- Signed MOA (mutual onboarding agreement) that specifies pilot scope and duration
- W-9 or equivalent tax docs on file
- Net30 payment terms for pilots under the invoice-only program

If you can return the completed vendor intake form + W-9, I'll route a one-time exception for this account to finance and legal. Tentative threshold I'm proposing for approval is up to $10,000 for the pilot period; finance may tighten this (see attached finance risk template).

I've attached: redwood_vendor_intake_form.pdf for you to fill out.

Next steps: you send the intake form + W-9 -> I loop finance/legal -> we'll send MOA for signature and confirm invoice-only window.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_vendor_intake_form.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Folks — forwarding Orbit Labs' request. They want a 90-day invoice-only onboarding while their internal PO process completes. Pilot spend expected at $3k–6k. Proposed controls: vendor intake + W-9 on file, signed MOA that limits liability and scope, net30 payment terms, and automatic review at 60 days.

Can finance/legal approve a one-time exception at up to $10k (upper bound) for pilots? If not, what threshold and controls would you need to sign off quickly so we don't lose momentum?

Attachments: vendor intake that I sent them; see finance_risk_matrix.xlsx (suggested controls and monitoring).

Thanks —
Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Jordan —

This is fine to escalate. Finance's preference would be:
- Temporary threshold: up to $7,500 for the pilot window (we prefer conservative caps)
- Duration: 90 days max, with an automatic billing review at day 45 and day 75
- Payment terms: Net30, AP contact on file (accounts-payable@orbitlabs.com)
- Required artifacts before we approve: completed vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf, orbit_w9.pdf, and a signed MOA (we can accept scanned signatures for pilots)

I'll sign off on the one-time exception if legal confirms MOA language and KYC docs are present. I've attached the finance_risk_matrix.xlsx with the controls I'd like included.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Attachment: finance_risk_matrix.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Thanks for the context. From legal:
- We can support a temporary invoice-only MOA for pilots. Require a short MOA that:
  1) Limits trial scope and term (90 days)
  2) Includes vendor indemnities and data handling commitments aligned with our standard onboarding (minimal redlines)
  3) Requires Orbit to provide W-9 and primary AP contact
- I'd like MOA review at signature stage; I'll prepare a light redline and share (moa_redline.docx).
- Recommend auto-terminate the invoice-only flag at the end of the pilot unless procurement confirms a standing PO.

If finance is comfortable with the $7.5k cap, legal is okay to proceed.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: moa_redline.docx
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <procurement@orbitlabs.com>, Accounts Payable <accounts-payable@orbitlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only request

Hi Olivia —

Good news: finance and legal can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for Orbit Labs with the following conditions (please review):
1) Pilot cap: $7,500 total for the 90-day pilot window
2) Required docs: completed redwood_vendor_intake_form (attached), W-9 (orbit_w9.pdf), and a signed MOA per our template
3) Payment terms: Net30; invoices to accounts-payable@orbitlabs.com
4) Monitoring: finance will review billing at day 45 and day 75; legal will rescind invoice-only status at pilot end unless a purchase order is issued

Next steps for Orbit:
- Return vendor_intake_form_filled.pdf and orbit_w9.pdf
- I will send the MOA (based on moa_redline.docx) for signature; once signed we can enable invoice-only billing and issue the first invoice after activation

I've attached the MOA draft (signed_moa_orbit_draft.docx) for your review. Let me know if you can get the intake form back by EOD Thursday so we can keep the pilot start on schedule.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

Attachments: signed_moa_orbit_draft.docx, redwood_vendor_intake_form.pdf
